decisions.briefing: Markets were broadly neutral today with NASDAQ +0.7% and S&P 500 +0.3%. With three open slots and cash above the deployment threshold, we filled them with diversified momentum picks (crypto mining, semiconductor test equipment, optical components) rather than concentrating in one correlated sector.

market_education.summary_en: Today's modest gains in both NASDAQ (+0.7%) and S&P 500 (+0.3%) reflect a quiet, low-volatility session without a dominant catalyst. No major company-specific headlines drove the broad market move today. The tone remained constructively neutral, consistent with a market digesting recent gains rather than reacting to new information.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日美股走勢溫和，納斯達克指數上漲0.7%，標普500指數上漲0.3%，整體屬於低波動、缺乏明顯主導消息的交易日。市場並未出現特別重大的個股或宏觀消息帶動大盤走勢。整體氣氛偏向中性偏多，較像是市場在消化近期升勢，而非對新消息作出反應。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Diversification means spreading investments across different sectors so that a downturn in one area doesn't sink your whole portfolio. Today's top candidates were heavily concentrated in bitcoin-mining stocks, which tend to move together, so picks were spread across mining, semiconductor testing, and optical components instead.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 分散投資是指將資金配置於不同產業，避免單一產業下跌時拖累整個投資組合。今日篩選出的高分股票大多集中在比特幣挖礦類股，這些股票往往同漲同跌，因此我們選擇分散至挖礦、半導體測試設備及光學元件等不同領域。
